reviewType: source-based release impact assessment, not an integration result
assessmentStatus: complete within declared scope; parent consolidation and compatibility decision pending

graphVerification.coverage: All 12 Go paths metadata_match/no_recorded_issue at final coverage generation; initial graph symbol/trace/snippet exploration used05:37:20Z. Direct source reads used for material behavior. Best effort; not a completeness proof.

scope.production: DC apps.openshift.io/v1; apps/v1 Deployments/ReplicaSets; autoscaling/v2 HPA; corev1 Pods/RCs/Services/Endpoints/quotas/limits/PVC/PV/Nodes/namespace labels; network policies/PDB; authorizationv1 SSAR/LSAR; OpenShift SCC subject review/AppliedClusterResourceQuota; optional admin policy discovery; image-trigger annotation/controller behavior. Full inventory in docs/compatibility-review.md.
scope.harness: Additional core/RBAC/Lease/Route/image/build/template/ClusterVersion/TokenRequest/isolated quota and storage fixtures from the documented inventory. Harness creates resources explicitly and cannot assume old server behavior from 4.21 execution.
scope.method: Read extracted candidates for 4.19/4.20, inspect surrounding source/mandatory API removal and known-issue sections, search full immutable release notes and errata modules by inventory/behavior; correlate relevant field/default/controller/accounting/storage/security changes with code, baseline catalog and primary upstream resource-accounting helpers. 4.21 includes immutable release-note assembly and all 51 retrieved referenced sources (50 content sources plus commit response); targeted relevant entries and complete section-heading scan, rather than claiming line-by-line review of every unrelated product feature.
scope.excluded: No cluster upgrade execution, no removed/manual post-baseline feature qualification, no guarantee of runtime image pulls/CSI mounts/network connectivity/CPUManager device or NUMA fit, no blanket validation of every platform-specific operator or all CVE fixed versions. These are prerequisites/explicit manual features, not missing API translation fixes.

limits: Older server integrations are unavailable; this record contains no synthetic integration passes.
API dry run and access reviews are current evidence, not a reservation or a guarantee against later RBAC/admission/quota/policy/capacity drift.

The existing preflight report explicitly says scheduler plugins, CSI attachment limits, volume mounting and external network dependencies are not simulated; runtime startup and recovery remain independently checked.
Client-library compilation/security and final exact-artifact integration qualification are consolidated parent work.

Advisory bullets relevant to tool operations were assessed; this is not a blanket claim that every patch is vulnerability-free or that Red Hat backports correspond one-to-one with upstream patch numbers.

findings.change: OpenShift4.21 explicitly uses Kubernetes1.34; DRA alpha serving removals and new beta admission API
findings.assessment: Official About-this-release explicitly maps1.34. Removed resource.k8s.io/v1alpha3 types and v1alpha4 DRA gRPC do not occur in either inventory; automatic ResourceClaims/custom-scheduler migrations require manual review. New MutatingAdmissionPolicy beta is server admission infrastructure, not a converter configuration API.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Retain endpoint discovery and raw server admission; actual 4.21.36 results remain specific to the exact artifact.

findings.change: PodLevelResources beta/default, hugepage/default/HPA/downwardAPI behavior; in-place resize conditions
findings.assessment: Target Pod budgets are refused before typed conversion, including admission defaults. Other running Pods raw spec.resources requests CPU/memory/hugepages override per-resource aggregate then overhead, matching official v1.34.9 PodRequests. Container observed requests/allocatedResources maxima match feasible resizing. For infeasible resize current spec-max may overestimate safely. No separate Pod-level status budget is used by1.34 helper; no demonstrated undercount from this review.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Existing observed-allocation contracts + sidecar/overhead tests. Do not infer new Pod target features are supported just because external allocations are counted.

findings.assessment: Nonempty probe/lifecycle host values and hostUsers=false+volumeDevices are existing fields whose validation changed; actual raw Pod create dryrun returns rejection before source mutation. hostUsers is preserved and defaults true per linkedguidance; isolated namespaces need compatible UID/GID/filesystems. findings.change: Container restart rules, EnvFiles/fileKeyRef, hostnameOverride; stricter supplemental groups inherited
findings.toolPaths: baseline.go raw field validation; converter.go input; constraints.go raw admission
findings.assessment: New container restartPolicy/restartPolicyRules, env FileKeyRef and Pod hostnameOverride are post-baseline fields, so unavailable typed knowledge cannot silently erase them. Native-sidecar restartPolicy/recursiveReadOnly/supplementalGroupsPolicy/seLinuxChangePolicy guards continue from earlier releases. Broader string enum validation is separate parent review; field presence alone is not an enum validator.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Keep representative raw input/SCC/Pod/create-response unknown-field contracts; parent will evaluate enum changes during SDK alignment.

findings.change: Default openshift ClusterImagePolicy active; signature mirroring issue in disconnected clusters; short-name pull fix
findings.toolPaths: converter.go image references/triggers; cutover.go Ready/HTTP; qualification image imports/builds
findings.assessment: Pod dryrun does not pull or prove signatures. Official known issue specifically concerns mirroring release images without Sigstore signatures and future CVO Pods, not a blanket statement that every arbitrary application image must have Red Hat signature. Workload image policy/trust/auth/mirror resolution must function on target nodes; unqualified image searches also have patch-dependent behavior. Converter preserves full image references and does not disable image policies.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Use immutable fully-qualified test images; explicitly validate required image signatures/credentials/mirrors before exclusive cutover. Startup failure tests/recovery do not prove everypossible imagepolicy.

findings.change: oVirt CSI Driver Operator removed; mutable CSI attach counts TP inOpenShift; resize/VolumeAttributesClass GA
findings.toolPaths: storage.go legacyplugin guard; scheduling.go boundPVC/PV topology; constraints.go declaredruntime limits; harnessstorage
findings.assessment: oVirt CSI operator removal is platform/driver availability, not removal of generic CSI Pod/PV API; do not block all CSI or assume old mounted volume proves a new mount. Users need a supported functioning driver. Tool does not write production claims/classes/snapshots/resize status or simulate dynamic CSI attach limits; regular CSI fixture cannot certify all vendor storage. RWO/RWX still recursive SELinux by default per linked 4.21 guidance; post-baseline namespace-injected seLinuxChangePolicy requires manual review.
findings.validationOrRequiredAction: Keep supported storage/data continuity and removed plugin refusal evidence; require external driver/attachment/mount review before exclusive cutover.

conclusion: No additional demonstrated unsafe acceptance in the conventional baseline feature path was established by this bounded source review. Existing guards preserve or refuse changed feature semantics, with named runtime/platform/storage/image/authorization prerequisites. This is input to the parent consolidated compatibility assumption; it is not a blanket per-patch support or integration pass.
